name: Wbcom Essential
description: Wbcom Essential is the required plugin to use REIGN theme to its maximum extent.

name: Elementor
description: The most advanced frontend drag & drop page builder. Create high-end, pixel perfect websites at record speeds. Any theme, any page, any design.

name: WP Job Manager
description: WP Job Manager is a lightweight job listing plugin for adding job-board like functionality to your WordPress site.

name: Reign WP Job Manager Addon
description: Reign WP Job Manager Addon provides seemless integration of WP Job Manager with Reign theme.

name: WP Job Manager – Company Profiles
description: Outputs a list of all companies that have submitted jobs with links to their listings and profile.

name: Regions for WP Job Manager
description: Adds a “Job Region” taxonomy so the site administrator can control a set of predefined regions listings can be assigned to.

name: Job Colors for WP Job Manager
description: Select the color of each existing job type in the Job Listings’ settings. Can set the color to be the background color, or text color.

name: BuddyBoss Platform
description: Buddyboss Platform adds community features to WordPress. Member Profiles, Activity Streams, Direct Messaging, Notifications, and more!

name: BuddyPress Job Manager
description: This plugin integrates WordPress Job Manager with BuddyPress. Allows the members to post jobs, and others to apply for those posted jobs.
